definitions.explanation: Expression of thankfulness for something received or done.
Something given in return for a favor or service.

examples.japanese: お{礼|れい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}いたい→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I want to express my thanks.

examples.japanese: お{礼|れい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
お{礼|れい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧⟦あげたい→あげる：00546_ageru⟧。
examples.english: I want to give something as thanks.

お{礼|れい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{渡|わた}す→渡す：02442_watasu⟧。

examples.english: I don't know how to thank you.

お{礼|れい}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{渡|わた}した→渡す：02442_watasu⟧。
examples.english: I gave money as a reward.

examples.japanese: お{礼|れい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{述|の}べる→述べる：02389_noberu⟧。
⟦{助|たす}けて→助ける：00895_tasukeru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧お{礼|れい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{菓子|かし}→お菓子：02852_okashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦いった→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I brought sweets as thanks for helping me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{落|お}とし{物|もの}→落とし物：08450_otoshimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{届|とど}けたら→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧、お{礼|れい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: When I turned in the lost item, I received a reward.

notes:
お{礼|れい} is the polite form of ⟦{礼|れい}→礼：02170_rei⟧, with the honorific お prefix. It covers both the feeling of gratitude and tangible expressions of thanks.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- お{礼|れい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to say thank you
- お{礼|れい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{述|の}べる→述べる：02389_noberu⟧: to express thanks (formal)
- お{礼|れい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧: I express my gratitude (very formal/keigo)
- お{礼|れい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in return, as thanks
- お{礼|れい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{品|しな}→品：03192_shina⟧: thank-you gift
- ⟦お{礼|れい}{状|じょう}→礼状：15365_reijou⟧: thank-you letter (formal)

MEANING DISTINCTION:
Sense 1 (gratitude) is far more common. Sense 2 (reward) often refers to money or gifts given in return for a favor, such as finding a lost item.

REGISTER:
Always polite due to the お prefix. The plain form ⟦{礼|れい}→礼：02170_rei⟧ exists but is rarely used alone in modern speech.
